schema:
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, cust_id INT);
CREATE TABLE lineitem (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, order_id INT, quantity INT, ship_date DATE, FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id));
correct_query: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(l.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.order_id = l.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id
